name: print-social-black-and-red-grow-your-business-ad-with-pointing-man
title: Black and red 'Grow Your Business' ad with a pointing man, crumpled texture and script quote
whatItIs: A square black ad with a crumpled-paper texture, a smiling man in a tweed blazer pointing at the viewer, red script 'Great ideas to' over bold white and red 'GROW YOUR Business', a red services list, a handwritten quote with an arrow and red circle outlines.
whatItMeans: Direct and persuasive; the pointing gesture makes the offer personal.
techniques: Pose the subject pointing at the viewer.
Mix handwritten script with heavy sans type.
Add a crumpled paper texture for grit.
Echo red outline circles off the edges.

vocabulary.definition: A pose or copy speaking straight to the viewer.
A scanned paper surface overlaid for tactility.
